Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 02f393381d14df948918f5021486e1197c05a21f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wojciech Drewek <wojciech.drewek@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2022 17:41:37 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] gtp: Fix inconsistent indenting

Fix the following warning as reported by smatch:

New smatch warnings:
drivers/net/gtp.c:1796 gtp_genl_send_echo_req() warn: inconsistent indenting

Fixes: d33bd757d362 ("gtp: Implement GTP echo request")
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Wojciech Drewek <wojciech.drewek@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Nguyen <anthony.l.nguyen@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/gtp.c b/drivers/net/gtp.c
index 756714d4ad92..a208e2b1a9af 100644
--- a/drivers/net/gtp.c
+++ b/drivers/net/gtp.c
@@ -1793,7 +1793,7 @@ static int gtp_genl_send_echo_req(struct sk_buff *skb, struct genl_info *info)
 	if (IS_ERR(rt)) {
 		netdev_dbg(gtp->dev, "no route for echo request to %pI4\n",
 			   &dst_ip);
-			   kfree_skb(skb_to_send);
+		kfree_skb(skb_to_send);
 		return -ENODEV;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/gtp.c`**
- The indentation of the line `kfree_skb(skb_to_send);` was corrected. It was previously indented inconsistently, which triggered a warning from the smatch static analysis tool.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a specific warning related to code style and consistency, as reported by the smatch tool. This change improves the readability and maintainability of the code by ensuring that the indentation is consistent with the surrounding code structure. The fix is part of a broader effort to maintain code quality, as indicated by the reported issue and the involvement of the kernel test robot.
